description.text:
The sixth POP Series set, 17 cards Pokémon Organized Play gave out in packs at its leagues and tournaments from September 2007 to March 2008.

Every card in the packs is non-holo. Holo copies came later in shop products: Gible and Pikachu in DP Value Pack 2 (November 2007), Riolu in Great Encounters blisters (March 2008), Chimchar, Piplup and Turtwig in starter blisters (May 2008) and the Diamond & Pearl Collection (August 2008), and Manaphy in Majestic Dawn blisters (June 2008). Pikachu also came with a Pokémon Day stamp, for those who came to Pokémon Day in the Netherlands in 2008.
